description: This file contains unit tests for the UserRoleManagerService class within the OrangeHRM core authorization service module. It tests methods related to obtaining and validating user role manager classes, including handling of class existence, inheritance validation, and user login state.

classes.name: InvalidUserRoleManager
classes.description: A dummy class used for testing invalid subclass scenario of user role manager.

classes.name: UnitTestUserRoleManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of AbstractUserRoleManager used in unit tests to simulate a valid user role manager.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for UserRoleManagerService, containing multiple test cases to verify correct behavior and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test case, creating a kernel environment.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the user role manager class name from configuration.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerExistingClass
methods.description: Tests obtaining an existing class that extends the abstract user role manager, and confirms user association.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerInvalidClass
methods.description: Verifies that the method throws an exception if the configured class does not subclass AbstractUserRoleManager.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNonExistingClass
methods.description: Checks behavior when the specified class does not exist in the codebase, expecting an exception.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNoLoggedInUser
methods.description: Tests the scenario where no user is logged in, expecting an exception indicating absence of user.
